svg.title: The shopping street, first of December, ten past five
svg.desc: A shopping street at dusk on the first of December with sale signs in four windows, a queue at a till, somebody holding a jacket up against themselves in a doorway, and somebody walking back towards a shop carrying a bag.

g.text: The shopping street, first of December, ten past five
Fourteen things to find. Three of the four sale signs give the old price. One does not.
the first shop - and the only one with a queue
SALE - 20, and no old price anywhere
SALE - and it does not say 89
Lin - holding the jacket against herself
the queue at the till - nine people
somebody walking back with a bag
a shop assistant, outside, on a break
the shop with one price and the most customers
SALE - and it does not say anything else
